name: gizza-ai/sqlite-table-to-csv
summary: Export a table from an SQLite database file as CSV

tool.description: Export one table of an SQLite database (.db/.sqlite) as CSV by parsing the on-disk file format (no SQL engine). Provide the file via `url` (a public http/https link) or `ref` (an uploaded attachment id). Pick a table by name (omit it if the database has only one table); choose the delimiter (comma/tab/semicolon/pipe), toggle the header row, set the text for NULL cells, optionally add a UTF-8 BOM, and cap the number of rows.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

table.description: Name of the table to export (case-insensitive). Omit it if the database has a single table; otherwise the tool lists the available tables.

delimiter.description: Field separator for the output. One of: comma (CSV), tab (TSV), semicolon, or pipe. Default comma.

header.description: Include a first row of column names. Default true.

null_value.description: Text to write for SQL NULL cells. Default is an empty field.

bom.description: Prepend a UTF-8 byte-order mark so Excel opens the CSV as UTF-8. Default false.

limit.description: Maximum number of data rows to export; 0 means all rows. Default 0.
